images.title: One tray, two tiles
images.purpose: Show that the same tray is covered by 24 squares or by 48 triangles when every square is cut from corner to corner, so a different tile gives a different count.
images.composition: The tray of squares on the left, the same tray cut into triangles on the right, an arrow between them.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 62, the heading One tray, two tiles in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). LEFT tray: exactly 24 square tiles in 4 rows of 6, every tile 70 by 70 px, filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), edge to edge, so the block of tiles is 420 px wide and 280 px tall at x 150 to 570 and y 250 to 530. RIGHT tray: the same block, 420 by 280 px at x 890 to 1310 and y 250 to 530, still made of 4 rows of 6 squares of 70 by 70 px, but every square is cut by one thin dark #2B2B2B line (3 px) from its top left corner to its bottom right corner into exactly 2 triangles, so there are 48 triangles, all filled amber #E69F00, each with the same dark outline. Between the two blocks, centred at x 730 and y 390, a dark #2B2B2B arrow 100 px long pointing right (shaft 8 px thick). Under the left block, centred at x 360 and y 590, the caption 24 squares; under the right block, centred at x 1100 and y 590, the caption 48 triangles, both in dark #1F2937 bold (40 px). In all 2 blocks, 24 squares, 48 triangles and 1 arrow. No other number and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a block with a number of squares other than 24 or of triangles other than 48, or a square cut into anything but 2 triangles
any other number or answer written anywhere in the frame
images.takeaway: The tray did not change, only the tile did: 24 square units is 48 triangle units.
images.description: A tray of 24 squares in 4 rows of 6, and the same tray with every square cut from corner to corner into 2 triangles, 48 in all.
images.context: Concept image for Area: The Region Covered. It follows the idea of the tables and the desk in your maths book (the same region covered by squares or by triangles) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count the squares of one row, then the triangles of one row. The slip to watch: thinking the region got bigger because there are more tiles.

image_decisions.why: Two pictures of one tray show that the area is counted in the tile used, and the count changes with the tile.
